purpose: Development crosswalk showing where Course 5 propagation, canopy, IPM scouting, biosecurity, authority-boundary and crop-care record objectives can be observed across Practicals C, D and E. Mapping coverage does not constitute practical validation, applicator authorization, evaluator calibration, inter-rater evidence, standard setting or release approval.

objectiveMappings.statement: Verify donor, lot, tray, plant and work-order identity and execute authorized propagation or transplant steps while preserving labels, counts, sanitation checkpoints and exception records.

practicalTasks: Verify donor identity, cultivar, target count and work order.
Prepare a clean workstation and stage labels before cutting.
Maintain unambiguous tray/lot identity.
Reconcile started, rooted, lost and handed-off counts.
Complete the propagation batch record and handoff.

objectiveMappings.statement: Execute authorized pruning, defoliation, support, spacing, training or related canopy work to the supplied standard while protecting plant identity, sanitation, tissue condition and recovery needs.

practicalTasks: Verify room, batch, stage and work-order objective.
Select the least disruptive action that satisfies the work order.
Apply supplied pruning/support/repositioning criteria consistently to simulated plants.
Recognize stop conditions such as active tissue splitting, severe stress or pest concerns.
Compare completed results with the stated structural objective.

objectiveMappings.statement: Follow a repeatable scouting route and document signs, symptoms, location, incidence, severity and trend without converting limited evidence into an unsupported pest or disease diagnosis.

practicalTasks: Follow the supplied route and identify high-risk inspection points.
Inspect representative canopy levels and leaf surfaces.
Classify provided findings as symptom, direct sign, mechanical damage, or insufficient evidence.
Calculate simple incidence from the supplied sample.
Assign supplied severity categories consistently.
Plot findings on the room map.
Compare with previous rounds and identify stable, increasing or resolving trends.

objectiveMappings.statement: Maintain facility sanitation, clean-to-dirty movement, tool-control and quarantine or isolation boundaries during propagation, crop care and scouting, and report any breach.

practicalTasks: Prepare clean scouting tools/PPE.
When a suspect finding threatens a clean area, preserve supplied clean-to-dirty movement, tool-control and isolation/quarantine boundaries; document and report any actual or potential breach.
Sequence tool sanitation correctly.

When donor material is suspect or outside acceptance criteria, preserve supplied clean-to-dirty movement and isolation/quarantine boundaries, segregate affected tools/material as instructed, and report any actual or potential breach.
Maintain sanitation and waste control.

When a pest concern, suspect plant or contaminated tool/waste condition is encountered, preserve supplied clean-to-dirty movement and isolation/quarantine boundaries and report any actual or potential breach before continuing in a clean area.

objectiveMappings.statement: Distinguish routine Technician I crop-care authority from work requiring a lead, specialist or licensed/authorized applicator, and stop or escalate when the supplied instruction or authorization boundary is exceeded.

practicalTasks: Choose appropriate escalation without making unauthorized pesticide or treatment-selection decisions.
Identify a batch exception without redesigning the protocol.
Recognize stop conditions such as active tissue splitting, severe stress or pest concerns.

objectiveMappings.statement: Create reconstructable propagation, canopy and IPM records that preserve identity, work completed, evidence observed, sanitation or quarantine actions, deviations, uncertainty and shift-handoff needs.

practicalTasks: Complete the scouting record and handoff.
Complete the propagation batch record and handoff.
Record scope completed, exceptions, damage and follow-up needs.
Provide a concise shift handoff.
